findings.what: Offer selection skips waiting patients who hold a pending offer for another slot, so the offer may not go to the literal first patient in the queue; this is not documented as a deviation
listAffectedAppointments loads all doctor_leave rows for all doctors with no date filter, so it slows down as leave history grows
A slot freed by patient reschedule is not offered to the waitlist (only cancellations trigger offers); documented, but partly works against Goal 1
If the offer email fails it is only logged; the offer still blocks the slot for other waitlisted patients for 30 minutes
